title: LintSignal
description: Lint signals from static-analysis tools such as ESLint, Stylelint, or Biome. Represents a collection of rule violations found in source files.

source.description: Metadata about the lint tool that produced these signals.

ruleSet.description: Rule set or configuration name used for the run (e.g. "recommended", "custom").

lintResult.description: A single lint rule violation at a specific location in a source file.

filePath.description: Path to the source file, relative to the repository root.

ruleId.description: Identifier of the lint rule that was violated (e.g. "no-unused-vars").

line.description: One-based line number where the violation starts.

column.description: Zero-based column number where the violation starts.

endLine.description: One-based line number where the violation ends, if available.

endColumn.description: Zero-based column number where the violation ends, if available.
